plan: Parse recipe, request, and catalog into internal structures without mutating inputs.
Scale all ingredient quantities and yield by target_yield / original_yield.

Apply catalog substitutions iteratively: for each ingredient, find best matching choice (lowest priority, then catalog order) whose 'for' matches ingredient id or name; apply result changes (quantity_factor, unit, preparation, equipment, wording_changes, additional ingredients).
After each substitution, check for cycles (ingredient reappearing) and exclusions; if cycle or exclusion, record reason and stop further substitutions for that ingredient.
Check equipment availability: collect all equipment from recipe and substitutions; if any not in available_equipment, record reason.
Check exclusions: after all substitutions, if any ingredient name is in excluded, record reason.
If any reasons exist, return impossible with sorted reasons and choices considered.
If possible, apply wording changes to instructions (replace old with new), sort equipment, ensure no excluded ingredients, and return adapted recipe with choices and warnings.
Implement print_original to return authored_text unchanged.
mechanisms: Deep copy of recipe to avoid mutation.
Priority queue or sorted list for catalog choices.
Cycle detection via visited ingredient ids.
Set operations for equipment and exclusions.
Fraction arithmetic for scaling and quantity factors.
